SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.
（批：S. B. D. 1639.
8 - 12 - 30.）
Translation of Despatch from the Shanghai Special District Court.
No. 4205. November 27, 1930.

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,
Re suppression of reactionary paper entitled
"Weekly Pictorial" (星期畫報).

I am in receipt of an instruction from the
Kiangsu High Court stating the following:-

"In the instruction from the Administrative
Department of the Judicial Yuan, quoting that
of the Judicial Yuan, it is stated that at the
instance of the Central Executive Committee, the
Nationalist Government has ordered the suppression
of two reactionary newspapers entitled "Weekly
Pictorial" (星期畫報) and "China Soviet
Weekly" (中國蘇維埃週報). It is alleged
that the drawings and articles on the respective
papers are absurd and inflammatory. If they
are not suppressed evil consequences will be
resulted. Therefore we (Kiangsu High Court) were
ordered to take the necessary steps and to
instruct all courts below accordingly re suppression
of the above mentioned reactionary papers.

In consequence of the above, you, the
President of the Shanghai Special District Court,
are
ordered to do accordingly."

With reference to the above I have to state that at
the instance of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau a request
has been forwarded to you for the suppression of the paper
entitled "Soviet Weekly" (蘇維埃週報) and you have
replied that the matter is receiving attention. Therefore

1930年12月8日。）
上海特区法院公函译文。
第4205号。1930年11月27日。

致上海公共租界工部局
警务总监。

先生，
关于查禁反动刊物《星期畫報》事宜。

本人收到江苏高等法院指令，内容如下：-

“在司法行政部转引司法院的指令中指出，奉中央执行委员会之请，国民政府下令查禁两种反动报纸，即《星期畫報》和《中國蘇維埃週報》。据称，各该报刊登的图画和文章荒谬且具煽动性。若不予查禁，将导致恶劣后果。因此，本院（江苏高等法院）奉命采取必要措施，并据此指示下级法院查禁上述反动刊物。

鉴于上述情况，你，上海特区法院院长，
奉命照此办理。”

鉴于上述情况，本人须说明，应上海公安局之请，已向你方发出查禁名为《蘇維埃週報》刊物的请求，而你方回复称此事正在处理中。因此

In consideration of the above instruction it is hereby
requested that the "Weekly Pictorial" ( 星期畫報 )
be added to the suppression list of reactionary papers.

President Yang Shao Shun.

Official S.B.

6 12 30
By K.P.Dung.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY No. D. 1637 Date 10. 10. 30.）

Translation of Despatch from the Shanghai Special District Court.
No. 5494. October 6, 1930

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,

Re Suppression of reactionary publications.

I am in receipt of a despatch from the Public Safety Bureau stating the following:-

"According to the report from the Postal censors attached to the Headquarters of the Woosung and Shanghai Garrison Commander, one reactionary paper entitled "Revolutionary Labourers" (革命工人) and 4 communistic papers entitled "Red Seamen" (赤色海員) "Bing Jang Weekly" (評論週報), "China and Soviet Pictorial Publications" (中國蘇維埃圖報) and "Dah Fong Daily News" (大風日報) were seized. This Bureau has also been instructed by the Headquarters of the Woosung and Shanghai Garrison Commander to find out the printing organs of these communistic papers known as "Red Flag" (紅旗), "Hai Kwang" (海光), "Tong Fang" (東方) and "Dah Fong" (大風).

"From the insertions in the respective papers, it is found that the "Revolutionary Labourers" is published by the Shanghai Revolutionary Labourers' Federation; "Red Seamen" edited by the Propaganda Committee of the National Seamen's Federation; "China and Soviet Pictorial Publications" by the propaganda committee of the Soviet's Central Tsung Pai Committee; and "Bing Jang Weekly" being one of the supplements to the Hai Kwaun Daily News

（批：Supt: S.B. 9/10/30.）
（批：13/10/30）

上海特区法院公函译文。
第5494号。1930年10月6日

致上海公共租界工部局
警务总监。

先生，

关于查禁反动出版物事宜。

本人收到公安局公函，内容如下：-

“据吴淞上海戒严司令部附属邮政检查员报告，查获一份名为《革命工人》的反动报纸，以及四份共产主义刊物，分别为《赤色海員》、《評論週報》、《中國蘇維埃圖報》和《大風日報》。吴淞上海戒严司令部亦指令本局查明名为《紅旗》、《海光》、《東方》和《大風》的这些共产主义刊物的印刷机构。

“从各报刊载的广告中发现，《革命工人》由上海革命工人联合会出版；《赤色海員》由全国海员总工会宣传委员会编辑；《中國蘇維埃圖報》由苏维埃中央总派委员会宣传委员会出版；而《評論週報》系《海光日报》的增刊之一，

（批注：警司：S.B. 1930年10月9日。）
（批注：1930年10月13日）

published by the Bing Jiang Weekly Press and circulated
through different schools, bookstores, and Woo Kyi
Association and all its branches. The address of
the editorial office of the Dah Fong Daily News is
inserted in the said paper to be at No.12 Zu Sing Li
Alleyway off Kwenning Road. But the result of an
investigation indicates that the address given is
a fictitious one as there is no alleyway by the name
of Zu Sing Li on Kwenning Road.
"After all, I shall conclude by saying that the
above mentioned papers being reactionary publications
should be strictly suppressed. Therefore you are
hereby requested to do accordingly."
In consideration of the above, I have to request that
you will give instructions to your subordinates to suppress the
above mentioned reactionary publications from time to time.

President Yang Shao Shun.

By K.P.Ding.

由《评论周报》社出版，并通过各学校、书店及五卅协会及其所有分会发行。《大风日报》编辑部的地址在该报上刊登为昆宁路（Kwenning Road）祖兴里12号。但调查结果显示，所给地址为虚构，因为昆宁路上并无名为祖兴里的弄堂。
“综上所述，本人结论是，上述报纸既属反动出版物，应予严厉查禁。因此，现请你方照此办理。”
鉴于上述情况，本人须请求你方指示下属不时查禁上述反动出版物。

院长 杨绍顺。

由 K.P.Ding 经办。

关于查禁反动报纸事宜。
据吴淞上海戒严司令部附属邮政检查员报告，查获一份名为《革命工人》的反动报纸，以及四份共产主义刊物，分别为《赤色海員》、《評論週報》、《中國蘇維埃畫報》和《大風日報》。吴淞上海戒严司令部亦指令本局查明名为《紅旗》、《海光》、《東方》和《大風》的这些共产主义刊物的印刷机构。
从各报刊载的广告中发现，《革命工人》由上海革命工人联合会出版；《赤色海員》由全国海员总工会宣传委员会编辑；《中國蘇維埃畫報》由苏维埃中央总派委员会宣传委员会出版；而《評論週報》系《海光日报》的增刊之一，由《评论周报》社出版，并通过各学校、书店及五卅协会及其所有分会发行。《大风日报》编辑部的地址刊登于
